doc.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23

title: First recording, Chicago 1925, with Richard M. Jones
summary: His first date was a 1925 pickup session for OKeh led by pianist Richard M. Jones, with Preston Jackson, Omer Simeon and Jabbo Smith; he cannot recall titles.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
